caption: The video captures a close, high-angle view of a flat black griddle on a gas stovetop, its left surface coated with a dull oil sheen bounded by an irregular edge while the right stays darker. A bright white reflection glows along the far-right edge, and the stove's grate bars and burner caps sit fixed below the front rim. Apart from minor jitter, the griddle and reflection hold their positions with no translation. Beneath the left burner, a blue gas flame flickers intermittently. It fades in and out repeatedly rather than igniting once or dying out. The irregular boundary of the oil film undulates slightly, its upper edge creeping rightward as the thin liquid shifts on the heated surface. The process is already underway and still continuing at the excerpt's end.
